name: Kantro
zh_summary: 專注於基本屬性來創建籃子並推薦定位，而非標普500目標或行業呼籲。經濟和EPS數據上升、市場最風險偏好的階段現在可能已經過去。相同主題可以持續，但相同公司很少在整個週期中跑贏。市場週期的高品質基本面階段已進入幾個月。
text: Some focus on S&P 500 targets, others like to make sector calls, we focus on fundamental attributes to create baskets and recommend positioning. The upswing of eco and EPS data is where markets trade the most “risk-on.” That phase is now likely behind us. You can still be invested in the same themes across the cycle, but the same companies within those themes rarely outperform across the entire cycle. We’re a few months into the “higher-quality fundamentals” phase of the market cycle.

name: Heisenberg
zh_summary: 賭場營運商股票WYNN、LVS及MGM昨日觸及18個月新低。這些高度週期性標的終將反彈，因為WYNN和LVS自GFC以來一直在月線圖上區間交易，現在再次接近該區間底部。
text:
Casino operator stocks all hitting fresh 18 month lows yesterday.

$WYNN $LVS $MGM

At some point these highly cyclical names have got to bounce…right?

I mean if you look at WYNN and LVS since exiting the GFC, all they have been doing is ranging trading for years (on the monthly chart) lol.

We are definitely getting close to the bottom of that range yet again.

name: Steve Hanke
zh_summary: 金融穩定中心貨幣供應衡量（Divisia M4）以熱門的每年7.5%增長，高於Hanke的黃金增長率6.3%/年，與聯儲2%通脹目標一致。毫不奇怪，聯儲調查的81%美國公司表示貨幣條件並不緊縮。
text:
Center for Financial Stability money supply measure (Divisia M4) is growing at a HOT 7.5%/yr, ABOVE Hanke’s Golden Growth Rate of 6.3%/yr, a rate consistent with the Fed’s 2% inflation target.

It's no surprise that 81% of US firms surveyed by the Fed say monetary conditions are not restrictive.

name: Serenity
zh_summary: 回應有關Fortune 100公司是否仍與SIVE合作生物感測的問題，對方表示這是非常長的週期，有許多事情需要處理。公開供應鏈推論顯示這是AAPL，基於5000萬單位RFQ商業規模、美國及技術重疊。若2028年發生，Apple將是錦上添花，而非核心論點。主要關注Sivers AI數據中心雷射收入增長。
text:
This was responding to a question this year whether their Fortune 100 was still working with $SIVE, given a lot of doubts. 

They qualified it’s a “very long cycle”, “they have a lot of things to work through because it’s a biosensing application” 

I use the word ~ likely since it’s not publicly disclosed. This is public supply chain inference that it’s $APPL, given 50M unit RFQ commercial scale, US, and technology/application overlap.

I’d argue Apple would be a cherry on top if it happens in 2028, not really any part of the core thesis. Main thing I’m looking for is Sivers AI DC laser revenue growth.
